title: Bulk RNA Sequencing (Mouse Brain)
author: Dain Lee
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Measure total RNA concentration
steps.instruction: Determine RNA concentration using Quant‑IT RiboGreen (cat no. R11490, Invitrogen).

steps.title: Assess RNA integrity
steps.instruction: Run RNA samples on a TapeStation RNA ScreenTape (cat no. 5067‑5576, Agilent) and retain only preparations with RIN > 7.0.

steps.title: Allocate input RNA
steps.instruction: Use 1 µg of high‑quality total RNA per sample for library construction with Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Prep Kit (cat no. 20020595).

steps.title: Purify poly‑A mRNA
steps.instruction: Capture poly‑A‑containing mRNA using poly‑T‑attached magnetic beads according to the TruSeq protocol.

steps.title: Fragment mRNA
steps.instruction: Fragment the purified mRNA into small pieces with divalent cations at elevated temperature (as specified in the kit).

steps.title: Synthesize first‑strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe fragmented RNA using SuperScript II reverse transcriptase (cat no. 18064014, Invitrogen) and random primers.

steps.title: Synthesize second‑strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Generate second‑strand cDNA using DNA Polymerase I, RNase H, and dUTP as described in the TruSeq workflow.

steps.title: End repair, A‑tailing, adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Perform end‑repair of cDNA fragments, add a single ‘A’ base, and ligate sequencing adapters.

steps.title: Purify and PCR‑enrich library
steps.instruction: Purify the adapter‑ligated cDNA and amplify by PCR to obtain the final cDNA library.

steps.title: Quantify library by qPCR
steps.instruction: Quantify the library using KAPA Library Quantification kit for Illumina (cat no. KK4854, Kapa Biosystems) following the qPCR Quantification Protocol Guide.

steps.title: Qualify library size distribution
steps.instruction: Assess library size and quality on a TapeStation D1000 ScreenTape (cat no. 5067‑5582, Agilent).

steps.title: Submit libraries for sequencing
steps.instruction: Pool indexed libraries and submit to Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (Illumina) for paired‑end 2 × 100 bp sequencing (performed by Macrogen, Inc., Daejeon, South Korea).
